description:
An original song for the hololive English new project "ENigmatic Recollection" Chapter 1.

Once upon a time, the girls are summoned to the mysterious Kingdom of Libestal. Unable to remember anything from before their arrival, they become entangled in the kingdom's conflicts. The girls are asked to defend the land from looming danger and are thusly entrusted with the kingdom's fate.

Ominous creatures---- ENigmatic stories lost within the kingdom----- What fate awaits them at the end of it all?

Expect a grand tale of adventure and valor starring all 19 hololive English members!

(Source: Youtube)
